WITH circuit_race_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    COUNT(*) as race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
total_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM races
),
num_circuits_with_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as num_circuits FROM circuit_race_counts
),
circuit_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    crc.circuitId,
    crc.race_count,
    CAST(crc.race_count AS FLOAT) / tr.total as share,
    1.0 / ncr.num_circuits as avg_share
  FROM circuit_race_counts crc
  CROSS JOIN total_races tr
  CROSS JOIN num_circuits_with_races ncr
),
filtered_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    race_count,
    share,
    share - avg_share as excess
  FROM circuit_stats
  WHERE share > avg_share
),
ranked_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    race_count,
    share,
    excess,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) as rnk
  FROM filtered_stats
)
SELECT 
  circuitId,
  race_count,
  share,
  excess
FROM ranked_stats
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY excess DESC
